notes: Ethereum mainnet (chain ID 1); chain selection is configured by the deployment service. Deploy the accepted Pepeolithic ERC-721 (PEPEO) with these 16 static arguments in ABI order: coin, admin, adam, seatRoot, startTime, caveLength, roundLength, firstPrice, floorPrice, then seven bytes32 ASCII labels right-padded with zeros in cave order. The supplied admin and Adam addresses are explicit recipients, independent of the factory caller. The nonpayable constructor makes no external calls and mints token 0 to Adam and token 736 to admin. The dead address 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD and ZTO's 18 decimals are contract constants, not constructor arguments. The sale starts at Unix 1791810000, with 86400-second caves and 3600-second rounds. Prices are ZTO base units: 1000000 ZTO initially and a 10000 ZTO floor. Of 737 pieces, 400 are sale pieces and 335 are seat pieces, plus the two constructor mints. Buy and leftover payments transfer ZTO directly from the buyer to dead; the contract takes no payment custody. Admin receives unsold sale pieces swept after cave close, is the fixed 1% royalty recipient, and may freeze each cave's metadata once. There is no ownership, upgrade or pause mechanism. Deployment requires no ETH funding or initialization calls.
